label: Governance and doctrine adoption
construct_definition: Extent to which the centre adopts adapts and governs protective-security and emergency doctrine with clear roles and update routines
observable_evidence_types: Local plans; role designations; revision logs; policy indexes
documentary_antecedents: Weak in RP-P1 (plan-lifecycle PEs inform gaps)
field_evidence_required: yes — local documents and role interviews
possible_observational_evidence: Presence of current local plan versions; role charts
relationship_to_RP_P1: Informed by planning/revision PE patterns; not measured by RP-P1
known_misinterpretation_risks: Equating existence of a plan with preparedness
prohibited_inference: Plan on shelf equals readiness; single score from A alone

label: Organisational sensing and threat detectability
construct_definition: Processes for concern reporting triage baseline-aware interpretation specialist input and false-positive safeguards
observable_evidence_types: Referral pathways; team composition; FP safeguards; review logs
documentary_antecedents: Family F inactive in RP-P1; reserved
possible_observational_evidence: Anonymised process maps; training attendance — not student risk scores
known_misinterpretation_risks: More reporting equals more safety; disability as threat cue
prohibited_inference: Pupil dangerousness scores; surveillance expansion as success

label: Decision authority and interagency coordination
construct_definition: Clarity of decision rights escalation paths and police/school/municipality coordination under acute threat
observable_evidence_types: Decision matrices; MOUs; contact trees; after-action coordination notes
documentary_antecedents: Weakly covered in RP-P1 doctrine audit
relationship_to_RP_P1: Gap signal only from RP-P1 silence/under-specification
known_misinterpretation_risks: Confusing coordination paperwork with real surge capacity

label: Protective-action executability
construct_definition: Whether prescribed protective actions are supported assessed tested and revised so they can be carried out under stated conditions by the occupant population
observable_evidence_types: Support inventories; drill design; executability checks; revision from exercise evidence
documentary_antecedents: Core RP-P1 ladder locus supports demands
field_evidence_required: yes — organisational capability and exercise evidence (Layers 2-4)
relationship_to_RP_P4: Must remain separate from Domain B
known_misinterpretation_risks: Treating RP-P1 documentary rung as school capability
prohibited_inference: Documents alone measure readiness; deficit framing of pupils

label: Inclusive access and functional supports
construct_definition: Named supports and access conditions that reduce task demands for diverse functional needs during protective actions
observable_evidence_types: PEEPs/PAI; communication aids; staffing ratios; accessible routes
documentary_antecedents: RP-P1 support and setting-differentiation codes; AFN benchmarks
relationship_to_RP_P1: Strong documentary antecedent; field required for adoption/capability
relationship_to_RP_P4: May inform B disability safeguards without merging models
known_misinterpretation_risks: Equating generic inclusivity language with supports
prohibited_inference: School type ranked by pupil impairment

label: Security-by-design and environmental conditions
construct_definition: Physical and environmental conditions that enable or inhibit protective actions and access under security constraints
observable_evidence_types: Lock hardware; egress; alert modalities; CPTED conflicts
known_misinterpretation_risks: Equating more hardening with more safety or accessibility

label: Training exercises and organisational learning
construct_definition: Quality of training and exercises including inclusive design and learning loops
observable_evidence_types: Training records; exercise scenarios; REX notes; inclusive drill adaptations
documentary_antecedents: RP-P1 training_drill and higher-rung testing/revision codes
relationship_to_RP_P1: Documentary drill/revision language informs indicators; field required
relationship_to_RP_P4: May include detection-exercise elements only via RP-P4 rules
known_misinterpretation_risks: Counting drill frequency as executability validation

label: Evidence use and revision
construct_definition: Use of exercise findings assessments and incidents to revise measures plans and supports
observable_evidence_types: Revision logs; version diffs; linked REX-to-change records
possible_observational_evidence: Before/after plan changes linked to evidence
relationship_to_RP_P1: Informed by RP-P1 rung-5 coding rules (provisional)
known_misinterpretation_risks: Optional learning language coded as proven adaptation
